k_of_n.quote: A cluster of any three (3) of the following positive provocation exam findings
at least 4 of the following criteria present

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Exclusions (lateral branch blocks, RF) and absolute/relative contraindications lists.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Same as Blue Shield of California: initial phase up to 2, >= 2 weeks apart; therapeutic needs >= 50% relief for >= 2 months; max 4 per 12 months per region; 2 years = new episode.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Sacroiliac joint injections may be repeated only as Medical Necessity.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: capitalized 'Medical Necessity' reads as if a defined term; no definition.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: For diagnostic purposes, all the following must be met

requirement_kinds.quote: Primarily axial low back pain (below level of L5)
average pain level of ≥ 6 on a scale of 0 to 10
cluster of any three (3) positive provocation exam findings
Duration of pain of at least 3 months
minimum of 6 weeks in the last 6 months
sacroiliitis on imaging: grade 2-4 bilaterally or grade 3-4 unilaterally
At least 75% pain relief ... after each diagnostic injection
A maximum of 4 sacroiliac joint injections may be performed in a 12-month period per region
pre-operative evaluation and plan for SIJ surgery
Each sacroiliac joint injection requires an authorization

thresholds.quote: at least 50% pain relief ... for a minimum of 2 months
maximum of 4 sacroiliac joint injections may be performed in a 12-month period

time_windows.quote: a minimum of 6 weeks in the last 6 months
at least two years from prior injections

external_dependencies.quote: Therapeutic sacroiliac joint injections for chronic pain is a covered benefit when all of the following conditions are met: With fluoroscopic guidance or CT guidance; After failure of conservative therapy; and No more than one without clinically meaningful improvement
in keeping with the benefit guidelines developed by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS)
